source_claim: Toei Animation's official Tropical-Rouge! Precure work page gives the series story and cast. It names Natsuumi Manatsu / Cure Summer, Suzumura Sango / Cure Coral, Ichinose Minori / Cure Papaya, Takizawa Asuka / Cure Flamingo, and Laura / Cure La Mer. Each exact identity matches a current Character tag in the residual campaign; the page is scoped to the named Tropical-Rouge! Precure title, whose exact in-catalog Copyright is tropical-rouge!_precure.
notes: The current official cast page also names Kururun, but no exact kururun tag appears in this campaign packet. Other Toei Precure works are not inferred from this title-scoped source; no broad Precure HOME is assigned.
